**Resubmitted — T4C: deviation, preferred-level cure (propose_redline ok:true, minimality ok).**

Repairs made to the Customer-side element in operative text:

1. **Grant, notice and refund (op 1).** 14.2.2 now reads: *"PB may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to SFJ, in which case SFJ will refund pro rata any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination."* Refund wording now uses the checklist noun ("prepaid fees", pro rata) rather than a paraphrase.
2. **Penalty removed so the right is genuinely unconditional (ops 2–3).** The 300% Development Cost exit payment conditioned PB's convenience termination and made it unusable, so it is deleted; the Trial Data Package acquisition under Section 11.1.1.4 is preserved, and the retained "reduced by the amount previously paid by PB to SFJ pursuant to this Section 14.2.2" credit is conformed to a full stop so no mechanic references a payment that no longer exists. This is not a fallback fee cap — no cap, instalment or formula was imported.
3. **Vendor bar, now numbered (op 4).** Inserted clause carries its number in the operative text: "14.2.11 No Termination for Convenience by SFJ. SFJ shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Term."

Unchanged: the Approval Payment continuation, Section 6.2 adjustment, Section 6.7 Buy-Out credit, and SFJ's event-triggered exits at 14.2.3, 14.2.6 and 14.2.10 with their payment formulas; the Section 5.2.2.2 cross-reference to 14.2.10 remains live. No survival tail, expense language or procedure was added.
